# UI recipes

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-recipes.ts from the example apps. -->

better-supabase ships no visible UI components. A recipe builds one component or one screen from your own shadcn components (web) or React Native primitives (native) and one or more blocks. Every recipe has web code; the ones that fit a phone also have native code, which calls the same hook. Both come from the example apps, `apps/examples/nextjs` and `apps/examples/expo-powersync`, so they typecheck and run.

Build the UI this way: add the shadcn components the recipe lists, install the glue items, then adapt the snippet to the app (its i18n, routes and API schema). Never add a better-supabase UI package; there is none.

## Notification bell

A header button with the unread count, which updates when a notification arrives or is read. Both sides call `useNotifications` from `better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react`; the [notifications block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/notifications) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add notifications`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/notification-bell.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/notifications-actions-next
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/notifications/components/unread-badge.tsx"
"use client";

import type { NotificationCounts } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications";

import { useNotifications } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react";
import { BellIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/hooks";

import { loadNotificationCounts } from "../notifications-actions";

async function loadCounts(): Promise<readonly NotificationCounts[]> {
  const result = await loadNotificationCounts({});

  return result.ok ? [result.data] : [];
}

const unreadOf = (counts: readonly NotificationCounts[]): number =>
  counts[0]?.unread ?? 0;

/**
 * The unread count from the block's `counts()`, loaded again after each
 * broadcast on the caller's private topic `notifications:<user id>`.
 */
function useUnreadCount() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const userId = auth.user?.id;

  const { items, count, status } = useNotifications({
    topic: userId ? `notifications:${userId}` : null,
    load: loadCounts,
    count: unreadOf,
  });

  return { count: items === undefined ? undefined : count, status };
}

/**
 * The header badge. Part of the static shell, so it loads from the browser
 * instead of adding a database call to every page.
 */
export function UnreadBadge() {
  const t = useExtracted("notifications");
  const { count, status } = useUnreadCount();

  return (
    <Link
      href="/notifications"
      className={buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" })}
      data-testid="unread-badge"
      data-status={status}
      aria-label={t("Notifications, {count, number} unread", {
        count: count ?? 0,
      })}
    >
      <BellIcon />
      <Badge
        variant={count ? "default" : "secondary"}
        className="tabular-nums"
        data-testid="unread-count"
      >
        {count ?? "–"}
      </Badge>
    </Link>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `Pressable`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/blocks
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/notification-bell.tsx"
import type { NotificationCounts } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications";

import { useNotifications } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth, useSupabase } from "better-supabase/react";
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { blocks } from "../lib/blocks";

const unreadOf = (counts: readonly NotificationCounts[]): number =>
  counts[0]?.unread ?? 0;

/** The unread count, loaded again after each broadcast on `notifications:<user id>`. */
export function NotificationBell({
  onPress,
}: {
  readonly onPress: () => void;
}) {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const tenant = tenantOf(auth);
  const userId = auth.user?.id;

  const { items, count } = useNotifications({
    topic: userId ? `notifications:${userId}` : null,
    load: async () => {
      if (!tenant) {
        return [];
      }

      const result = await blocks(supabase).notifications.counts({ tenant });

      return result.ok ? [result.data] : [];
    },
    count: unreadOf,
  });

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={`Notifications, ${String(count)} unread`}
      style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8, padding: 8 }}
    >
      <Text>Notifications</Text>
      <View
        style={{
          minWidth: 24,
          borderRadius: 12,
          paddingHorizontal: 8,
          backgroundColor: count ? "#111" : "#e5e5e5",
        }}
      >
        <Text style={{ color: count ? "#fff" : "#111", textAlign: "center" }}>
          {items === undefined ? "–" : count}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}
```

## Notification list

The caller's latest notifications with an unread marker, loaded again on every change. Both sides call `useNotifications` from `better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react`; the [notifications block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/notifications) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add notifications`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/notification-list.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge empty skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/notifications-actions-next
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/notifications/components/notification-list.tsx"
"use client";

import { useNotifications } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react";
import { BellIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/hooks";

import type { NotificationRow } from "../notification-types";

import { loadNotifications } from "../notifications-actions";

async function loadRows(): Promise<readonly NotificationRow[]> {
  const result = await loadNotifications({});

  return result.ok ? result.data : [];
}

/**
 * The caller's latest notifications, loaded again after each broadcast on
 * their private topic `notifications:<user id>`: a new one, or one marked read.
 */
export function NotificationList() {
  const t = useExtracted("notifications");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const auth = useAuth();
  const userId = auth.user?.id;

  const { items } = useNotifications({
    topic: userId ? `notifications:${userId}` : null,
    load: loadRows,
  });

  if (items === undefined) {
    return <NotificationListSkeleton />;
  }

  if (items.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Empty className="border">
        <EmptyHeader>
          <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
            <BellIcon />
          </EmptyMedia>
          <EmptyTitle>{t("Nothing here yet")}</EmptyTitle>
          <EmptyDescription>
            {t("Send yourself a notification to see it arrive.")}
          </EmptyDescription>
        </EmptyHeader>
      </Empty>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border">
      {items.map((notification) => (
        <li
          key={notification.id}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
        >
          <span className="flex-1">{notification.title}</span>
          {notification.readAt ? null : <Badge>{t("New")}</Badge>}
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            {format.dateTime(new Date(notification.createdAt), {
              dateStyle: "medium",
              timeStyle: "short",
            })}
          </span>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function NotificationListSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2" aria-busy="true">
      {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, index) => (
        <Skeleton key={index} className="h-11 w-full" />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `FlatList`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/blocks
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/notification-list.tsx"
import { useNotifications } from "better-supabase/blocks/notifications/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth, useSupabase } from "better-supabase/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, FlatList, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { blocks } from "../lib/blocks";

/**
 * The caller's latest notifications, loaded again after each broadcast on
 * their private topic `notifications:<user id>`: a new one, or one marked read.
 */
export function NotificationList() {
  const auth = useAuth();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const tenant = tenantOf(auth);
  const userId = auth.user?.id;

  const { items } = useNotifications({
    topic: userId ? `notifications:${userId}` : null,
    load: async () => {
      if (!tenant) {
        return [];
      }

      const result = await blocks(supabase).notifications.list({
        tenant,
        limit: 20,
      });

      return result.ok ? result.data : [];
    },
  });

  if (items === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <FlatList
      data={items}
      keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
      ListEmptyComponent={<Text>Nothing here yet</Text>}
      renderItem={({ item }) => (
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, paddingVertical: 12 }}>
          <Text style={{ flex: 1 }}>{item.data.title}</Text>
          {item.readAt ? null : <Text style={{ fontWeight: "600" }}>New</Text>}
          <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>
            {item.createdAt.toLocaleString(undefined, {
              dateStyle: "medium",
              timeStyle: "short",
            })}
          </Text>
        </View>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

## Command search

A search dialog over the search index, with favorites and recents before the user types. Both sides call `useCommandSearch` from `better-supabase/blocks/search/react`; the [search block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/search) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add search`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/command-search.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button dialog input
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/search/components/command-search.tsx"
"use client";

import { useCommandSearch } from "better-supabase/blocks/search/react";
import { SearchIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

/** The API schema `gen` wrote for the search block. */
const API_SCHEMA = blockConfig.search.api;

/** Cmd+K over the search index: customers by name, plus recents and favorites. */
export function CommandSearch() {
  const t = useExtracted("search");
  const search = useCommandSearch({ schema: API_SCHEMA });

  const heading = (key: string) => {
    if (key === "favorites") {
      return t("Favorites");
    }

    if (key === "recents") {
      return t("Recent");
    }

    if (key === "customer") {
      return t("Customers");
    }

    return key;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        aria-label={t("Search")}
        aria-keyshortcuts="Meta+K Control+K"
        onClick={() => {
          search.setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        <SearchIcon />
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">{t("Search")}</span>
        <kbd className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground sm:inline">⌘K</kbd>
      </Button>
      <Dialog open={search.open} onOpenChange={search.setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="gap-4 sm:max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("Search")}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {t("Find a customer by name, even with a typo.")}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <Input
            type="search"
            value={search.query}
            onChange={(event) => {
              search.setQuery(event.target.value);
            }}
            placeholder={t("Search customers")}
            aria-label={t("Search customers")}
          />
          <div className="max-h-80 overflow-y-auto" aria-live="polite">
            {search.error === undefined ? null : (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive">
                {t("Search failed. Try again.")}
              </p>
            )}
            {search.groups.length === 0 && !search.loading ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {search.query.trim() === ""
                  ? t("Type to search.")
                  : t("No matches.")}
              </p>
            ) : null}
            {search.groups.map((group) => (
              <section key={group.key} className="mb-3">
                <h3 className="mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  {heading(group.key)}
                </h3>
                <ul>
                  {group.items.map((item) => (
                    <li key={`${item.subjectType}:${item.subjectId}`}>
                      <Link
                        href={item.url ?? "/"}
                        onClick={() => void search.select(item)}
                        className="block rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 outline-none hover:bg-muted focus-visible:bg-muted"
                      >
                        {item.title ?? item.subjectId}
                      </Link>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </section>
            ))}
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `Modal`, `Pressable`, `SectionList`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/command-search.tsx"
import { useCommandSearch } from "better-supabase/blocks/search/react";
import {
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  SectionList,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

function heading(key: string): string {
  if (key === "favorites") {
    return "Favorites";
  }

  if (key === "recents") {
    return "Recent";
  }

  if (key === "customer") {
    return "Customers";
  }

  return key;
}

/** Search over the search index: customers by name, plus recents and favorites. */
export function CommandSearch() {
  // Native has no Cmd+K, so the button opens it.
  const search = useCommandSearch({ schema: API_SCHEMA, shortcut: false });

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="button"
        onPress={() => {
          search.setOpen(true);
        }}
        style={{ padding: 8 }}
      >
        <Text>Search</Text>
      </Pressable>
      <Modal
        visible={search.open}
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => {
          search.setOpen(false);
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 12, padding: 16 }}>
          <TextInput
            value={search.query}
            onChangeText={search.setQuery}
            placeholder="Search customers"
            accessibilityLabel="Search customers"
            style={{ borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 8 }}
          />
          {search.error === undefined ? null : (
            <Text>Search failed. Try again.</Text>
          )}
          <SectionList
            sections={search.groups.map((group) => ({
              key: group.key,
              title: heading(group.key),
              data: group.items,
            }))}
            keyExtractor={(item) => `${item.subjectType}:${item.subjectId}`}
            renderSectionHeader={({ section }) => (
              <Text style={{ color: "#737373", marginTop: 12 }}>
                {section.title}
              </Text>
            )}
            renderItem={({ item }) => (
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="link"
                onPress={() => void search.select(item)}
                style={{ paddingVertical: 8 }}
              >
                <Text>{item.title ?? item.subjectId}</Text>
              </Pressable>
            )}
            ListEmptyComponent={
              search.loading ? null : (
                <Text>
                  {search.query.trim() === ""
                    ? "Type to search."
                    : "No matches."}
                </Text>
              )
            }
          />
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            onPress={() => {
              search.setOpen(false);
            }}
          >
            <Text>Close</Text>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Onboarding checklist

The organization's getting-started steps with progress, hidden once every step is done. Both sides call `useOnboarding` from `better-supabase/blocks/onboarding/react`; the [onboarding block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/onboarding) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add onboarding`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/onboarding-checklist.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button card progress skeleton
```

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/onboarding-checklist
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/dashboard/components/onboarding-card.tsx"
"use client";

import { useOnboarding } from "better-supabase/blocks/onboarding/react";
import { tenantOf } from "better-supabase/react";
import { CheckCircle2Icon, CircleIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { gettingStarted } from "@/features/onboarding/checklist";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

/** The API schema `gen` wrote for the onboarding block. */
const API_SCHEMA = blockConfig.onboarding.api;

/** The organization's getting-started checklist; hidden once every step is done. */
export function OnboardingCard() {
  const t = useExtracted("dashboard");
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth()) ?? null;

  const { progress } = useOnboarding(gettingStarted, {
    organizationId,
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  if (progress === undefined) {
    return <OnboardingCardSkeleton />;
  }

  if (progress.done) {
    return null;
  }

  const titles = {
    customer: t("Add your first customer"),
    invite: t("Invite a teammate"),
    "api-key": t("Create an API key"),
    plan: t("Review your plan"),
  };

  return (
    <Card data-testid="onboarding">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Get started")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("{completed, number} of {total, number} steps done", {
            completed: progress.completed,
            total: progress.total,
          })}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        <Progress value={(progress.completed / progress.total) * 100} />
        <ul className="divide-y">
          {progress.steps.map((step) => (
            <li key={step.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 py-2">
              {step.completed ? (
                <CheckCircle2Icon className="size-4 text-primary" />
              ) : (
                <CircleIcon className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              )}
              <span
                className={
                  step.completed
                    ? "flex-1 text-muted-foreground line-through"
                    : "flex-1"
                }
              >
                {titles[step.id]}
              </span>
              {step.completed ? null : (
                <Link
                  href={step.href ?? "/"}
                  className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}
                >
                  {t("Start")}
                </Link>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function OnboardingCardSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```bash
npx shadcn add @better-supabase/onboarding-checklist
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/onboarding-checklist.tsx"
import { useOnboarding } from "better-supabase/blocks/onboarding/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";
import { gettingStarted } from "../lib/onboarding";

/** The organization's getting-started checklist; hidden once every step is done. */
export function OnboardingChecklist() {
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth()) ?? null;

  const { progress } = useOnboarding(gettingStarted, {
    organizationId,
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  if (progress === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  if (progress.done) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8, padding: 16, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 12 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>Get started</Text>
      <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>
        {progress.completed} of {progress.total} steps done
      </Text>
      <View style={{ height: 6, borderRadius: 3, backgroundColor: "#e5e5e5" }}>
        <View
          style={{
            height: 6,
            borderRadius: 3,
            backgroundColor: "#111",
            width: `${(progress.completed / progress.total) * 100}%`,
          }}
        />
      </View>
      {progress.steps.map((step) => (
        <Text
          key={step.id}
          style={
            step.completed
              ? { color: "#737373", textDecorationLine: "line-through" }
              : undefined
          }
        >
          {step.completed ? "✓" : "○"} {step.title}
        </Text>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Comment thread

A record's comments with their authors and a form to add one, kept current after each write. Both sides call `useComments` from `better-supabase/blocks/comments/react`; the [comments block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/comments) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add comments`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/comment-thread.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button field skeleton textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/comment-thread.tsx"
"use client";

import { useComments } from "better-supabase/blocks/comments/react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { type SubmitEvent, useId, useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

/** A customer's comments, oldest first, through the browser client. */
export function CommentThread({
  organizationId,
  customerId,
  authors,
  canComment,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  customerId: string;
  /** Display names by user id. */
  authors: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
  canComment: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const fieldId = useId();
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const { comments, error, add } = useComments({
    organizationId,
    subjectType: "customer",
    subjectId: customerId,
    schema: blockConfig.comments.api,
  });

  const visible = comments?.filter((comment) => !comment.deletedAt);

  const submit = async (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const text = body.trim();

    if (!text) {
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);

    if ((await add(text)).ok) {
      setBody("");
    }

    setPending(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {visible === undefined ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-16" />
      ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("No comments yet.")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ol className="space-y-4" data-testid="comments">
          {visible.map((comment) => (
            <li key={comment.id} className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-sm">
                <span className="font-medium">
                  {(comment.authorId && authors[comment.authorId]) ??
                    t("Someone")}
                </span>{" "}
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {format.dateTime(comment.createdAt.epochMilliseconds, {
                    dateStyle: "medium",
                    timeStyle: "short",
                  })}
                </span>
              </p>
              <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{comment.body}</p>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )}
      {canComment ? (
        <form onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="space-y-3">
          <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-comment-body`} className="sr-only">
              {t("Comment")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Textarea
              id={`${fieldId}-comment-body`}
              value={body}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setBody(event.target.value);
              }}
              placeholder={t("Write a comment")}
              required
              maxLength={4000}
              rows={3}
            />
            {error ? <FieldError>{errorMessage(error)}</FieldError> : null}
          </Field>
          <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={pending}>
            {t("Comment")}
          </Button>
        </form>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Button`, `FlatList`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/comment-thread.tsx"
import { useComments } from "better-supabase/blocks/comments/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Button,
  FlatList,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/** A customer's comments, oldest first, with a box to add one. */
export function CommentThread({ customerId }: { readonly customerId: string }) {
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth());
  const [body, setBody] = useState("");
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const { comments, error, add } = useComments({
    organizationId,
    subjectType: "customer",
    subjectId: customerId,
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  const submit = async () => {
    const text = body.trim();

    if (!text) {
      return;
    }

    setPending(true);

    if ((await add(text)).ok) {
      setBody("");
    }

    setPending(false);
  };

  if (comments === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 12 }}>
      <FlatList
        data={comments.filter((comment) => !comment.deletedAt)}
        keyExtractor={(comment) => comment.id}
        ListEmptyComponent={<Text>No comments yet.</Text>}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={{ paddingVertical: 8 }}>
            <Text style={{ color: "#737373", fontSize: 12 }}>
              {item.createdAt.toLocaleString()}
            </Text>
            <Text>{item.body}</Text>
          </View>
        )}
      />
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
      <TextInput
        value={body}
        onChangeText={setBody}
        placeholder="Write a comment"
        multiline
        maxLength={4000}
        style={{ borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 8, minHeight: 64 }}
      />
      <Button
        title="Comment"
        disabled={pending || !body.trim()}
        onPress={() => void submit()}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Organization switcher

A menu of the user's organizations that switches the active one and refreshes the session for its tenant claim. Both sides call `useOrganizations` from `better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react`; the [organizations block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/organizations) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add organizations`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/org-switcher.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add dropdown-menu sidebar
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/organization/components/organization-switcher-menu.tsx"
"use client";

import { DbException } from "better-supabase";
import { useOrganizations } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { CheckIcon, ChevronsUpDownIcon, PlusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuGroup,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { SidebarMenuButton } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { OrganizationSummary } from "../organization-queries";

import { loadMyOrganizations } from "../organization-actions";
import { useRefreshSession } from "../use-refresh-session";
import { useRoleLabel } from "../use-role-label";
import { CreateOrganizationDialog } from "./create-organization-dialog";

function Mark({ name }: { name: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex aspect-square size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-sidebar-primary text-sm font-semibold text-sidebar-primary-foreground">
      {name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}
    </div>
  );
}

async function loadOrganizations(): Promise<readonly OrganizationSummary[]> {
  const result = await loadMyOrganizations({});

  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new DbException(result.error);
  }

  return result.data;
}

/**
 * The organization menu. The server renders it with its rows; switching
 * goes through `switch_organization`, refreshes the session for the new
 * tenant claim, then re-renders the server tree.
 */
export function OrganizationSwitcherMenu({
  initial,
  activeId: serverActiveId,
}: {
  initial: readonly OrganizationSummary[];
  activeId: string | null;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("organization");
  const roleLabel = useRoleLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const refreshSession = useRefreshSession();
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);

  const { organizations, active, activeId, switchTo } = useOrganizations({
    load: loadOrganizations,
    initial,
    activeId: serverActiveId,
    schema: blockConfig.organizations.api,
    onSwitched: () => refreshSession("/"),
  });

  const choose = (organization: OrganizationSummary) => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      const result = await switchTo(organization.id);

      if (!result.ok) {
        toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));

        return;
      }

      toast.success(t("Switched to {name}", { name: organization.name }));
    });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger
          disabled={pending}
          render={
            <SidebarMenuButton
              size="lg"
              className="data-popup-open:bg-sidebar-accent"
              aria-label={t("Switch organization")}
            />
          }
        >
          <Mark name={active?.name ?? "?"} />
          <div className="grid flex-1 text-left text-sm leading-tight">
            <span
              className="truncate font-medium"
              data-testid="organization-name"
            >
              {active?.name ?? t("No organization")}
            </span>
            <span className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground capitalize">
              {active ? active.plan : t("Create one to start")}
            </span>
          </div>
          <ChevronsUpDownIcon className="ml-auto" />
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent className="w-64" align="start" side="bottom">
          <DropdownMenuGroup>
            <DropdownMenuLabel>{t("Organizations")}</DropdownMenuLabel>
            {(organizations ?? initial).map((organization) => (
              <DropdownMenuItem
                key={organization.id}
                className="gap-2"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (organization.id !== activeId) {
                    choose(organization);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Mark name={organization.name} />
                <div className="grid flex-1 leading-tight">
                  <span className="truncate">{organization.name}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {roleLabel(organization.role)}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {organization.id === activeId ? <CheckIcon /> : null}
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            ))}
          </DropdownMenuGroup>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onClick={() => {
              setCreating(true);
            }}
          >
            <PlusIcon />
            {t("Create organization")}
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
      <CreateOrganizationDialog open={creating} onOpenChange={setCreating} />
    </>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/organization-switcher.tsx"
import { useOrganizations } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/**
 * The caller's organizations. Pressing one switches to it, refreshes the
 * session so the token carries the new tenant, and loads the list again.
 */
export function OrganizationSwitcher() {
  const { organizations, activeId, switching, error, switchTo } =
    useOrganizations({ schema: API_SCHEMA });

  if (organizations === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>Organizations</Text>
      {organizations.map((organization) => (
        <Pressable
          key={organization.id}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityState={{
            selected: organization.id === activeId,
            busy: organization.id === switching,
          }}
          disabled={switching !== undefined || organization.id === activeId}
          onPress={() => void switchTo(organization.id)}
          style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, paddingVertical: 8 }}
        >
          <Text style={{ width: 16 }}>
            {organization.id === activeId ? "✓" : ""}
          </Text>
          <Text style={{ flex: 1 }}>{organization.name}</Text>
          <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>{organization.role}</Text>
        </Pressable>
      ))}
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Plan picker

The plans with their prices and a checkout button each. Checkout starts in a server action or API route that holds the Stripe key, and the client opens the URL it returns. Both sides call `usePlanPicker` from `better-supabase/blocks/billing/react`; the [billing block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/billing) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add billing`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/plan-picker.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button card
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/billing/components/plan-picker.tsx"
"use client";

import type { PlanCatalog } from "better-supabase/blocks/billing/react";
import type { Money } from "better-supabase/commerce";

import { DbException } from "better-supabase";
import { usePlanPicker } from "better-supabase/blocks/billing/react";
import { formatMoney } from "better-supabase/commerce";
import { useExtracted, useLocale } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardFooter,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { PlanOption } from "../billing-queries";

import { loadPlanCatalog, startCheckout } from "../billing-actions";

async function loadCatalog(): Promise<PlanCatalog<PlanOption>> {
  const result = await loadPlanCatalog({});

  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new DbException(result.error);
  }

  return result.data;
}

/**
 * The plans with a checkout button each. The server renders the catalog;
 * `choose` runs the `startCheckout` server action, which talks to Stripe,
 * and sends the browser to the Checkout URL it returns.
 */
export function PlanPicker({
  initial,
  canManage,
}: {
  initial: PlanCatalog<PlanOption>;
  canManage: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("billing");
  const locale = useLocale();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const { plans, current, pending, choose } = usePlanPicker({
    load: loadCatalog,
    initial,
    checkout: (plan) => startCheckout({ plan }),
    open: (url) => {
      window.location.assign(url);
    },
  });

  const price = (value: Money) =>
    value.amount === 0n
      ? t("Free")
      : t("{price} per month", { price: formatMoney(value, locale) });

  const featureLabel = ({ key, value }: PlanOption["features"][number]) => {
    switch (key) {
      case "seats": {
        return t("{seats} seats", { seats: String(value) });
      }

      case "exports": {
        return t("CSV exports");
      }

      case "audit": {
        return t("Audit log");
      }

      case "sso": {
        return t("Single sign-on");
      }

      default: {
        return key;
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
      {(plans ?? initial.plans).map((plan) => {
        const active = plan.key === current;

        return (
          <Card key={plan.key} size="sm" data-testid="plan">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{plan.name}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>{price(plan.price)}</CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <ul className="space-y-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {plan.features.map((feature) => (
                  <li key={feature.key}>{featureLabel(feature)}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </CardContent>
            <CardFooter>
              <Button
                className="w-full"
                variant={active ? "secondary" : "default"}
                data-testid={active ? "active-plan" : undefined}
                disabled={active || !canManage || pending !== undefined}
                onClick={() => {
                  void choose(plan.key).then((started) => {
                    if (!started.ok) {
                      toast.error(errorMessage(started.error));
                    }
                  });
                }}
              >
                {active
                  ? t("Current plan")
                  : pending === plan.key
                    ? t("Opening checkout")
                    : t("Switch")}
              </Button>
            </CardFooter>
          </Card>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/plan-picker.tsx"
import { usePlanPicker } from "better-supabase/blocks/billing/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import * as WebBrowser from "expo-web-browser";
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { loadPlanCatalog, startCheckout } from "../lib/billing";

const price = (cents: number) =>
  cents === 0 ? "Free" : `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)} per month`;

/**
 * The plans with a checkout button each. `choose` posts to the app's own
 * API route, which talks to Stripe, and opens the Checkout URL it returns
 * in the system browser.
 */
export function PlanPicker() {
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth());

  const { plans, current, pending, error, choose } = usePlanPicker({
    load: () =>
      organizationId
        ? loadPlanCatalog(organizationId)
        : Promise.resolve({ plans: [], current: undefined }),
    checkout: startCheckout,
    open: async (url) => {
      await WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync(url);
    },
  });

  if (plans === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>Plans</Text>
      {plans.map((plan) => {
        const active = plan.key === current;

        return (
          <Pressable
            key={plan.key}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityState={{
              selected: active,
              busy: pending === plan.key,
            }}
            disabled={active || pending !== undefined}
            onPress={() => void choose(plan.key)}
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              gap: 8,
              padding: 12,
              borderWidth: 1,
              borderRadius: 12,
              borderColor: active ? "#111" : "#e5e5e5",
            }}
          >
            <Text style={{ flex: 1, fontWeight: "600" }}>{plan.name}</Text>
            <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>{price(plan.priceCents)}</Text>
            <Text>
              {active ? "Current" : pending === plan.key ? "Opening" : "Switch"}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        );
      })}
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Usage meter

This period's usage per meter against the plan's quota, with the reset date. Both sides call `useUsageMeter` from `better-supabase/blocks/usage/react`; the [usage block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/usage) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add usage`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/usage-meter.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add card progress skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/dashboard/components/usage-card.tsx"
"use client";

import { useUsageMeter } from "better-supabase/blocks/usage/react";
import { tenantOf } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";

import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";

/** The API schema `gen` wrote for the usage block. */
const API_SCHEMA = blockConfig.usage.api;

/** This period's usage per meter against the plan's quota. */
export function UsageCard() {
  const t = useExtracted("dashboard");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth()) ?? null;

  const { meters } = useUsageMeter({
    organizationId,
    meters: ["api.calls", "customers.created"],
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  if (!organizationId) {
    return null;
  }

  if (meters === undefined) {
    return <UsageCardSkeleton />;
  }

  const labels = new Map([
    ["api.calls", t("API calls")],
    ["customers.created", t("Customers added")],
  ]);

  return (
    <Card data-testid="usage">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Usage this period")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t("Counted by the usage module, limited by your plan.")}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-5">
        {meters.map((meter) => (
          <div key={meter.meter} className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="font-medium">
                {labels.get(meter.meter) ?? meter.meter}
              </span>
              <span
                className={
                  meter.exceeded
                    ? "text-destructive tabular-nums"
                    : "text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
                }
              >
                {meter.limit === undefined
                  ? t("{used} used, no limit", {
                      used: format.number(meter.used),
                    })
                  : t("{used} of {limit}", {
                      used: format.number(meter.used),
                      limit: format.number(meter.limit),
                    })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <Progress value={(meter.fraction ?? 0) * 100} />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {t("Resets {date}", {
                date: format.dateTime(
                  new Date(meter.resetsAt.epochMilliseconds),
                  { dateStyle: "medium" },
                ),
              })}
            </p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function UsageCardSkeleton() {
  return <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" aria-busy="true" />;
}
```

## Feature gate

Content shown only when the active organization's plan includes a feature, read from the session's features claim and updated when the session refreshes. Both sides call `useFeatureGate` from `better-supabase/blocks/entitlements/react`; the [entitlements block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/entitlements) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add entitlements`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/feature-gate.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/billing/components/feature-gate.tsx"
"use client";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { useFeatureGate } from "better-supabase/blocks/entitlements/react";
import { LockIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import type { Entitlement } from "@/lib/claims";

import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Link } from "@/i18n/navigation";

/**
 * Renders `children` only when the active organization's plan includes
 * `feature`, read from the session's `features` claim; otherwise a link to
 * the plans. UX only: RLS and the route behind it check the feature too.
 */
export function FeatureGate({
  feature,
  children,
}: {
  feature: Entitlement;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("billing");
  const { allowed } = useFeatureGate(feature);

  if (allowed === undefined) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-8 w-28" aria-busy="true" />;
  }

  if (allowed) {
    return children;
  }

  return (
    <Link
      href="/settings/billing"
      className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}
      data-testid={`upgrade-${feature}`}
    >
      <LockIcon />
      {t("Upgrade to unlock")}
    </Link>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/feature-gate.tsx"
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import { useFeatureGate } from "better-supabase/blocks/entitlements/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Text, View } from "react-native";

/**
 * Renders `children` only when the active organization's plan includes
 * `feature`, read from the session's `features` claim. UX only: RLS checks
 * the feature too.
 */
export function FeatureGate({
  feature,
  children,
}: {
  readonly feature: string;
  readonly children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const { allowed } = useFeatureGate(feature);

  if (allowed === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  if (allowed) {
    return children;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ padding: 12, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 12 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontWeight: "600" }}>Not in your plan</Text>
      <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>
        Upgrade to a plan with {feature} to use this.
      </Text>
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Settings layout

Settings pages generated from the settings definition: a section per scope and a control per key, picked by the kind its schema declares. Both sides call `useSettings` from `better-supabase/blocks/settings/react`; the [settings block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/settings) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add settings`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/settings-layout.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add card field input select skeleton switch
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/settings/components/settings-layout.tsx"
"use client";

import type { SettingEntries } from "better-supabase/blocks/settings";
import type {
  SettingField,
  SettingsState,
} from "better-supabase/blocks/settings/react";

import { useSettings } from "better-supabase/blocks/settings/react";
import { tenantOf } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/hooks";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { settings } from "../settings-definition";

/** The API schema `gen` wrote for the settings block. */
const API_SCHEMA = blockConfig.settings.api;

/** What a control produces; the key's schema validates it before it is stored. */
type ControlValue = string | number | boolean;

/** The control for one field, picked by the kind its schema declares. */
function SettingControl({
  id,
  field,
  value,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  id: string;
  field: SettingField;
  value: unknown;
  disabled: boolean;
  onChange: (value: ControlValue) => void;
}) {
  switch (field.kind) {
    case "boolean": {
      return (
        <Switch
          id={id}
          checked={value === true}
          disabled={disabled}
          onCheckedChange={(checked: boolean) => {
            onChange(checked);
          }}
        />
      );
    }

    case "choice": {
      const items = field.choices.map((choice) => ({
        value: String(choice),
        label: String(choice),
      }));

      return (
        <Select
          value={String(value)}
          items={items}
          disabled={disabled}
          onValueChange={(next) => {
            const choice = field.choices.find((each) => String(each) === next);

            if (choice !== undefined) {
              onChange(choice);
            }
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger id={id} className="w-48 capitalize">
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {items.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem
                key={item.value}
                value={item.value}
                className="capitalize"
              >
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      );
    }

    case "number":
    case "text":
    case "json": {
      return (
        <Input
          id={id}
          className="w-48"
          type={field.kind === "number" ? "number" : "text"}
          defaultValue={field.kind === "json" ? "" : String(value ?? "")}
          disabled={disabled || field.kind === "json"}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            const next = event.currentTarget.value;
            onChange(field.kind === "number" ? Number(next) : next);
          }}
        />
      );
    }

    default: {
      const unknown: never = field.kind;

      return unknown;
    }
  }
}

/** One scope of the definition as a card: a row per key, saved on change. */
function SettingsSection<E extends SettingEntries>({
  title,
  description,
  editable,
  state,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  editable: boolean;
  state: SettingsState<E>;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("settings");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const baseId = useId();

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{title}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>{description}</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {state.values === undefined ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-16" aria-busy="true" />
        ) : (
          <FieldGroup>
            {state.fields.map((field) => (
              <Field key={field.key} orientation="horizontal">
                <FieldContent>
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${baseId}-${field.key}`}>
                    {field.title ?? field.key}
                  </FieldLabel>
                  {field.description ? (
                    <FieldDescription>{field.description}</FieldDescription>
                  ) : null}
                  {editable ? null : (
                    <FieldDescription>
                      {t("Only admins can change this.")}
                    </FieldDescription>
                  )}
                </FieldContent>
                <SettingControl
                  id={`${baseId}-${field.key}`}
                  field={field}
                  value={state.values?.[field.key]}
                  disabled={!editable || state.saving === field.key}
                  onChange={(value) => {
                    void state.setField(field.key, value).then((saved) => {
                      if (!saved.ok) {
                        toast.error(errorMessage(saved.error));
                      }
                    });
                  }}
                />
              </Field>
            ))}
          </FieldGroup>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

/**
 * The preferences page, generated from `settings-definition.ts`: a card per
 * scope and a control per key, each saved through the settings module.
 */
export function SettingsLayout({
  canEditOrganization,
}: {
  canEditOrganization: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("settings");
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth()) ?? null;
  const user = useSettings(settings, { scope: "user", schema: API_SCHEMA });

  const organization = useSettings(settings, {
    scope: "organization",
    organizationId,
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6" data-testid="settings-layout">
      <SettingsSection
        title={t("Your preferences")}
        description={t("Only you see these.")}
        editable
        state={user}
      />
      {organizationId ? (
        <SettingsSection
          title={t("Organization defaults")}
          description={t("Shared by everyone in the organization.")}
          editable={canEditOrganization}
          state={organization}
        />
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Pressable`, `ScrollView`, `Switch`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/settings-layout.tsx"
import type { SettingEntries } from "better-supabase/blocks/settings";
import type {
  SettingField,
  SettingsState,
} from "better-supabase/blocks/settings/react";

import { useSettings } from "better-supabase/blocks/settings/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Switch,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";
import { settings } from "../lib/settings";

/** What a control produces; the key's schema validates it before it is stored. */
type ControlValue = string | number | boolean;

/** The control for one field, picked by the kind its schema declares. */
function SettingControl({
  field,
  value,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  readonly field: SettingField;
  readonly value: unknown;
  readonly disabled: boolean;
  readonly onChange: (value: ControlValue) => void;
}) {
  switch (field.kind) {
    case "boolean": {
      return (
        <Switch
          value={value === true}
          disabled={disabled}
          onValueChange={onChange}
        />
      );
    }

    case "choice": {
      return (
        <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 6 }}>
          {field.choices.map((choice) => (
            <Pressable
              key={String(choice)}
              accessibilityRole="radio"
              accessibilityState={{ checked: choice === value, disabled }}
              disabled={disabled}
              onPress={() => {
                onChange(choice);
              }}
              style={{
                paddingHorizontal: 10,
                paddingVertical: 6,
                borderWidth: 1,
                borderRadius: 8,
                borderColor: choice === value ? "#111" : "#e5e5e5",
              }}
            >
              <Text>{String(choice)}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </View>
      );
    }

    case "number":
    case "text":
    case "json": {
      return (
        <TextInput
          defaultValue={field.kind === "json" ? "" : String(value ?? "")}
          editable={!disabled && field.kind !== "json"}
          keyboardType={field.kind === "number" ? "numeric" : "default"}
          onEndEditing={(event) => {
            const next = event.nativeEvent.text;
            onChange(field.kind === "number" ? Number(next) : next);
          }}
          style={{ minWidth: 120, borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 6 }}
        />
      );
    }

    default: {
      const unknown: never = field.kind;

      return unknown;
    }
  }
}

/** One scope of the definition: a row per key, saved on change. */
function SettingsSection<E extends SettingEntries>({
  title,
  state,
}: {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly state: SettingsState<E>;
}) {
  if (state.values === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>{title}</Text>
      {state.fields.map((field) => (
        <View key={field.key} style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 12 }}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Text>{field.title ?? field.key}</Text>
            {field.description ? (
              <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>{field.description}</Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
          <SettingControl
            field={field}
            value={state.values?.[field.key]}
            disabled={state.saving === field.key}
            onChange={(value) => void state.setField(field.key, value)}
          />
        </View>
      ))}
      {state.error ? (
        <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{state.error.message}</Text>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

/** The preferences screen, generated from the settings definition. */
export function SettingsLayout() {
  const organizationId = tenantOf(useAuth()) ?? null;
  const user = useSettings(settings, { scope: "user", schema: API_SCHEMA });

  const organization = useSettings(settings, {
    scope: "organization",
    organizationId,
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  return (
    <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 24, padding: 16 }}>
      <SettingsSection title="Your preferences" state={user} />
      {organizationId ? (
        <SettingsSection title="Organization defaults" state={organization} />
      ) : null}
    </ScrollView>
  );
}
```
