## Members table

An organization's members with their roles, where a role change shows at once and a member can be removed. Both sides call `useMembers` from `better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react`; the [organizations block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/organizations) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add organizations`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/members-table.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add avatar button select table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/organization/components/member-table.tsx"
"use client";

import { DbException } from "better-supabase";
import { useMembers } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { UserMinusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import * as v from "valibot";

import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { RoleBadge } from "@/features/user/components/role-badge";
import { assignableRoles } from "@/features/user/user-permissions";
import { Role } from "@/lib/claims";
import { initials } from "@/lib/initials";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import type { Member } from "../organization-queries";

import { loadMembers, memberChanged } from "../organization-actions";
import { useRoleLabel } from "../use-role-label";

async function loadOrganizationMembers(): Promise<readonly Member[]> {
  const result = await loadMembers({});

  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new DbException(result.error);
  }

  return result.data;
}

/**
 * The organization's members. The server renders the rows; a role change
 * shows at once and goes through `update_member_role` in the browser.
 */
export function MemberTable({
  organizationId,
  initial,
  currentUserId,
  myRole,
  canUpdateRole,
  canRemove,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  initial: readonly Member[];
  currentUserId: string;
  myRole: Role;
  canUpdateRole: boolean;
  canRemove: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("organization");
  const roleLabel = useRoleLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const format = useFormatter();

  const { members, pending, setRole, remove } = useMembers({
    organizationId,
    load: loadOrganizationMembers,
    initial,
    schema: blockConfig.organizations.api,
    onChanged: async ({ userId }) => {
      await memberChanged({ userId });
    },
  });

  const assignable = assignableRoles(myRole);

  const roleItems = assignable.map((role) => ({
    value: role,
    label: roleLabel(role),
  }));

  // Nobody changes their own role or an owner's here; ownership moves by transfer.
  const editable = (member: Member) =>
    member.userId !== currentUserId &&
    member.role !== "owner" &&
    assignable.includes(member.role);

  const busy = (member: Member) => pending.includes(member.userId);

  const changeRole = async (member: Member, role: Role) => {
    const result = await setRole(member.userId, role);

    if (result.ok) {
      toast.success(t("Role updated"));
    } else {
      toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
    }
  };

  const removeMember = async (member: Member) => {
    const result = await remove(member.userId);

    if (result.ok) {
      toast.success(t("Member removed"));
    } else {
      toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
    }
  };

  return (
    <Table data-testid="members">
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead>{t("Member")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead>{t("Role")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="hidden sm:table-cell">{t("Joined")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead className="w-10" />
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {(members ?? initial).map((member) => (
          <TableRow
            key={member.userId}
            aria-busy={busy(member) ? true : undefined}
            className={busy(member) ? "opacity-50" : undefined}
          >
            <TableCell>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Avatar className="size-8">
                  {member.avatarUrl ? (
                    <AvatarImage src={member.avatarUrl} alt="" />
                  ) : null}
                  <AvatarFallback>
                    {initials(member.name, member.email)}
                  </AvatarFallback>
                </Avatar>
                <div className="grid leading-tight">
                  <span className="font-medium">
                    {member.name ?? member.email}
                    {member.userId === currentUserId ? (
                      <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                        {" "}
                        ({t("you")})
                      </span>
                    ) : null}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {member.email}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              {canUpdateRole && editable(member) ? (
                <Select
                  value={member.role}
                  items={roleItems}
                  disabled={busy(member)}
                  onValueChange={(value) => {
                    if (v.is(Role, value)) {
                      void changeRole(member, value);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger
                    size="sm"
                    className="w-32"
                    aria-label={t("Role")}
                  >
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {roleItems.map((item) => (
                      <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                        {item.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              ) : (
                <RoleBadge role={member.role} />
              )}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground sm:table-cell">
              {member.joinedAt
                ? format.dateTime(new Date(member.joinedAt), {
                    dateStyle: "medium",
                  })
                : "–"}
            </TableCell>
            <TableCell>
              {canRemove && editable(member) ? (
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="icon-sm"
                  disabled={busy(member)}
                  aria-label={t("Remove {name}", {
                    name: member.name ?? member.email ?? "",
                  })}
                  onClick={() => {
                    void removeMember(member);
                  }}
                >
                  <UserMinusIcon />
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/members-table.tsx"
import { useMembers } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/**
 * The active organization's members. Pressing a role switches it between
 * member and admin at once; the organizations module refuses a role above
 * the caller's, and the row shows the old role again.
 */
export function MembersTable() {
  const auth = useAuth();

  const { members, pending, error, setRole, remove } = useMembers({
    organizationId: tenantOf(auth),
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  if (members === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>Members</Text>
      {members.map((member) => {
        const busy = pending.includes(member.userId);

        const editable =
          member.userId !== auth.user?.id && member.role !== "owner";

        const next = member.role === "admin" ? "member" : "admin";

        return (
          <View
            key={member.userId}
            accessibilityState={{ busy }}
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 8,
              paddingVertical: 8,
              opacity: busy ? 0.5 : 1,
            }}
          >
            <Text style={{ flex: 1 }} numberOfLines={1}>
              {member.userId === auth.user?.id ? "You" : member.userId}
            </Text>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityHint={editable ? `Changes the role to ${next}` : ""}
              disabled={!editable || busy}
              onPress={() => void setRole(member.userId, next)}
            >
              <Text style={{ color: editable ? "#2563eb" : "#737373" }}>
                {member.role}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
            {editable ? (
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                disabled={busy}
                onPress={() => void remove(member.userId)}
              >
                <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>Remove</Text>
              </Pressable>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        );
      })}
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Invite dialog

A form that invites a teammate by email with a role, then shows the token for the accept link. Both sides call `useInvitations` from `better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react`; the [invitations block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/invitations) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add invitations`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/invite-dialog.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button dialog field input select
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/organization/components/invite-member-dialog.tsx"
"use client";

import { useInvitations } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { CopyIcon, UserPlusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { type SubmitEvent, useId, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import * as v from "valibot";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Field,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { assignableRoles } from "@/features/user/user-permissions";
import { Role } from "@/lib/claims";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { invitationSent } from "../organization-actions";
import { useInviteLink } from "../use-invite-link";
import { useRoleLabel } from "../use-role-label";

/**
 * Invites a teammate through `invite_member` in the browser, then shows the
 * accept link: the example has no mailer.
 */
export function InviteMemberDialog({
  organizationId,
  myRole,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  myRole: Role;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("organization");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const roleLabel = useRoleLabel();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const inviteLink = useInviteLink();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState<Role>("member");

  const roles = assignableRoles(myRole).map((each) => ({
    value: each,
    label: roleLabel(each),
  }));

  // The server renders the pending list; `invitationSent` renders it again.
  const { invite, inviting, sent, error, clear } = useInvitations({
    organizationId,
    schema: blockConfig.organizations.api,
    onChanged: async ({ kind }) => {
      if (kind === "invited") {
        await invitationSent({});
      }
    },
  });

  const link = sent ? inviteLink(sent.token) : null;

  const message =
    error === undefined
      ? null
      : error.kind === "conflict"
        ? t("That person is already a member or invited.")
        : errorMessage(error);

  const submit = async (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    await invite({ email: email.trim().toLowerCase(), role });
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        setOpen(next);
        setEmail("");

        if (!next) {
          clear();
        }
      }}
    >
      <DialogTrigger render={<Button size="sm" />}>
        <UserPlusIcon />
        {t("Invite")}
      </DialogTrigger>
      <DialogContent>
        {link ? (
          <div className="grid gap-6">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{t("Invitation created")}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                {t("Send this link. It works once and expires in seven days.")}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Input
                value={link}
                readOnly
                aria-label={t("Invitation link")}
                data-testid="invite-link"
              />
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="icon"
                aria-label={t("Copy link")}
                onClick={() => {
                  void navigator.clipboard
                    .writeText(link)
                    .then(() => toast.success(t("Link copied")));
                }}
              >
                <CopyIcon />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose render={<Button />}>{t("Done")}</DialogClose>
            </DialogFooter>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="grid gap-6">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{t("Invite a teammate")}</DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription>
                {t(
                  "They join with the role you pick. You can't give a role above your own.",
                )}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <FieldGroup>
              <Field data-invalid={message ? true : undefined}>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-invite-email`}>
                  {t("Email")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Input
                  id={`${fieldId}-invite-email`}
                  name="email"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setEmail(event.target.value);
                  }}
                  required
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
                {message ? <FieldError>{message}</FieldError> : null}
              </Field>
              <Field>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-invite-role`}>
                  {t("Role")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <Select
                  value={role}
                  items={roles}
                  onValueChange={(value) => {
                    if (v.is(Role, value)) {
                      setRole(value);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger id={`${fieldId}-invite-role`} className="w-40">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {roles.map((each) => (
                      <SelectItem key={each.value} value={each.value}>
                        {each.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </Field>
            </FieldGroup>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose render={<Button type="button" variant="outline" />}>
                {t("Cancel")}
              </DialogClose>
              <Button type="submit" disabled={inviting}>
                {t("Send invitation")}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </form>
        )}
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `Button`, `Modal`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/invite-dialog.tsx"
import { useInvitations } from "better-supabase/blocks/organizations/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Modal, Pressable, Text, TextInput, View } from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

const ROLES = ["member", "admin"] as const;

/**
 * A button that opens a form to invite a teammate by email with a role,
 * then shows the token for the accept link (the example has no mailer).
 */
export function InviteDialog() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState<(typeof ROLES)[number]>("member");

  const { invitations, invite, inviting, sent, error, clear } = useInvitations({
    organizationId: tenantOf(useAuth()),
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  const close = () => {
    setOpen(false);
    setEmail("");
    clear();
  };

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 4 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>
        Pending invitations
      </Text>
      {invitations?.map((invitation) => (
        <Text key={invitation.id}>
          {invitation.email} ({invitation.role})
        </Text>
      ))}
      <Button
        title="Invite"
        onPress={() => {
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      />
      <Modal visible={open} animationType="slide" onRequestClose={close}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, gap: 12, padding: 24 }}>
          {sent ? (
            <>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>
                Invitation created
              </Text>
              <Text>Send this token in the accept link. It works once.</Text>
              <Text selectable style={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
                {sent.token}
              </Text>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>
                Invite a teammate
              </Text>
              <TextInput
                value={email}
                onChangeText={setEmail}
                placeholder="Email"
                keyboardType="email-address"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                autoComplete="off"
                style={{ borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 8 }}
              />
              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
                {ROLES.map((each) => (
                  <Pressable
                    key={each}
                    accessibilityRole="radio"
                    accessibilityState={{ checked: each === role }}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setRole(each);
                    }}
                    style={{
                      borderWidth: 1,
                      borderRadius: 16,
                      paddingHorizontal: 12,
                      paddingVertical: 4,
                      backgroundColor: each === role ? "#e5e5e5" : undefined,
                    }}
                  >
                    <Text>{each}</Text>
                  </Pressable>
                ))}
              </View>
              {error ? (
                <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text>
              ) : null}
              <Button
                title="Send invitation"
                disabled={inviting || !email.trim()}
                onPress={() =>
                  void invite({ email: email.trim().toLowerCase(), role })
                }
              />
            </>
          )}
          <Button title={sent ? "Done" : "Cancel"} onPress={close} />
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

## API keys table

The organization's API keys, with a form that creates one and shows its token once, and a revoke button per key. Both sides call `useApiKeys` from `better-supabase/blocks/api-keys/react`; the [api-keys block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/api-keys) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add api-keys`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/api-keys-table.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert badge button dialog empty field input skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/api-keys/components/api-key-table.tsx"
"use client";

import { useApiKeys } from "better-supabase/blocks/api-keys/react";
import { KeyRoundIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { apiKeyCreated } from "../api-key-actions";
import { CreateApiKeyDialog } from "./create-api-key-dialog";

/**
 * The organization's API keys through the browser client, with a button
 * that creates one and shows its token once. Members without
 * `api_keys.manage` create `personal` keys, which act as them.
 */
export function ApiKeyTable({
  organizationId,
  personal,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  personal: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("apiKeys");
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const format = useFormatter();

  const { keys, created, creating, revoking, error, create, revoke, dismiss } =
    useApiKeys({
      organizationId,
      schema: blockConfig["api-keys"].api,
      onChanged: async ({ kind }) => {
        if (kind === "created") {
          await apiKeyCreated({});
        }
      },
    });

  const revokeKey = async (id: string) => {
    const result = await revoke(id);

    if (result.ok) {
      toast.success(t("Key revoked"));
    } else {
      toast.error(errorMessage(result.error));
    }
  };

  const date = (value: Temporal.Instant | undefined) =>
    value
      ? format.dateTime(new Date(value.epochMilliseconds), {
          dateStyle: "medium",
        })
      : "–";

  const dialog = (
    <CreateApiKeyDialog
      token={created?.token}
      creating={creating}
      error={error}
      onCreate={async (name) => {
        await create({ name, personal });
      }}
      onClose={dismiss}
    />
  );

  if (keys === undefined) {
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <div className="flex justify-end">{dialog}</div>
        <Skeleton className="h-32" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="flex justify-end">{dialog}</div>
      {keys.length === 0 ? (
        <Empty>
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
              <KeyRoundIcon />
            </EmptyMedia>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("No API keys yet")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t("Create one to call the API from a script.")}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <Table data-testid="api-keys">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("Name")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("Key")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
                {t("Created")}
              </TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
                {t("Last used")}
              </TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-24" />
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {keys.map((key) => (
              <TableRow
                key={key.id}
                aria-busy={revoking.includes(key.id) ? true : undefined}
                className={revoking.includes(key.id) ? "opacity-50" : undefined}
              >
                <TableCell className="font-medium">
                  {key.name}{" "}
                  {key.userId ? (
                    <Badge variant="outline">{t("Personal")}</Badge>
                  ) : null}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                  {key.prefix}_{key.publicId}…
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                  {date(key.createdAt)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="hidden text-muted-foreground md:table-cell">
                  {date(key.lastUsedAt)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-right">
                  {key.state === "revoked" || key.state === "expired" ? (
                    <Badge variant="secondary">{t("Revoked")}</Badge>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      disabled={revoking.includes(key.id)}
                      onClick={() => {
                        void revokeKey(key.id);
                      }}
                    >
                      {t("Revoke")}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Button`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/api-keys-table.tsx"
import { useApiKeys } from "better-supabase/blocks/api-keys/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Button,
  Pressable,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/**
 * The organization's API keys with a field that creates one, whose token
 * shows only until it is dismissed, and a revoke button per key. Members
 * who can't manage the organization's keys create personal ones.
 */
export function ApiKeysTable({ personal = false }: { personal?: boolean }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");

  const { keys, created, creating, revoking, error, create, revoke, dismiss } =
    useApiKeys({ organizationId: tenantOf(useAuth()), schema: API_SCHEMA });

  const submit = async () => {
    if ((await create({ name: name.trim(), personal })).ok) {
      setName("");
    }
  };

  if (keys === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>API keys</Text>
      {keys.map((key) => {
        const revoked = key.state === "revoked" || key.state === "expired";

        return (
          <View
            key={key.id}
            style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}
          >
            <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
              <Text>{key.name}</Text>
              <Text style={{ color: "#737373", fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
                {key.prefix}_{key.publicId}…
              </Text>
            </View>
            {revoked ? (
              <Text style={{ color: "#737373" }}>Revoked</Text>
            ) : (
              <Pressable
                accessibilityRole="button"
                disabled={revoking.includes(key.id)}
                onPress={() => void revoke(key.id)}
              >
                <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>Revoke</Text>
              </Pressable>
            )}
          </View>
        );
      })}
      {created ? (
        <View style={{ gap: 4, padding: 8, backgroundColor: "#f5f5f5" }}>
          <Text>Copy the key now. It is not shown again.</Text>
          <Text selectable style={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
            {created.token}
          </Text>
          <Button title="Done" onPress={dismiss} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
      <TextInput
        value={name}
        onChangeText={setName}
        placeholder="Key name, such as CI"
        maxLength={80}
        style={{ borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 8 }}
      />
      <Button
        title="Create key"
        disabled={creating || !name.trim()}
        onPress={() => void submit()}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Audit log table

The audit trail, newest first, with filters by actor and action and older pages on demand. Both sides call `useAuditLog` from `better-supabase/blocks/audit/react`; the [audit block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/audit) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add audit`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/audit-log-table.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button select skeleton table
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/audit/components/audit-log-table.tsx"
"use client";

import { useAuditLog } from "better-supabase/blocks/audit/react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

const ALL = "all";

/** The values a filter offers: those on the loaded page, and the one it has. */
function choices(
  values: readonly (string | undefined)[],
  current: string | undefined,
): readonly string[] {
  return [
    ...new Set([...values, current].filter((value) => value !== undefined)),
  ].toSorted();
}

/**
 * The organization's audit trail through the browser client, newest first,
 * filtered by actor and action. The audit module's read policy decides
 * which entries the caller sees.
 */
export function AuditLogTable({ organizationId }: { organizationId: string }) {
  const t = useExtracted("audit");
  const format = useFormatter();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const { entries, filters, hasMore, loading, error, setFilters, loadMore } =
    useAuditLog({ organizationId, schema: blockConfig.audit.api });

  const actors = new Map(
    (entries ?? []).flatMap((entry) =>
      entry.actorId ? [[entry.actorId, entry.actorLabel ?? entry.actorId]] : [],
    ),
  );

  const actions = choices(
    (entries ?? []).map((entry) => entry.eventType),
    filters.eventType,
  );

  const actorItems = [
    { value: ALL, label: t("Every actor") },
    ...choices([...actors.keys()], filters.actorId).map((id) => ({
      value: id,
      label: actors.get(id) ?? id,
    })),
  ];

  const actionItems = [
    { value: ALL, label: t("Every action") },
    ...actions.map((action) => ({ value: action, label: action })),
  ];

  const pick = (value: string | null): string | undefined =>
    value === null || value === ALL ? undefined : value;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Select
          value={filters.actorId ?? ALL}
          items={actorItems}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            void setFilters({ ...filters, actorId: pick(value) });
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-48" aria-label={t("Actor")}>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {actorItems.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Select
          value={filters.eventType ?? ALL}
          items={actionItems}
          onValueChange={(value) => {
            void setFilters({ ...filters, eventType: pick(value) });
          }}
        >
          <SelectTrigger size="sm" className="w-56" aria-label={t("Action")}>
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            {actionItems.map((item) => (
              <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                {item.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>
      {error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{errorMessage(error)}</p>
      ) : null}
      {entries === undefined ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-64" />
      ) : entries.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {t("Nothing recorded yet.")}
        </p>
      ) : (
        <Table data-testid="audit-events">
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead>{t("When")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead>{t("Event")}</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
                {t("Actor")}
              </TableHead>
              <TableHead className="hidden md:table-cell">
                {t("Target")}
              </TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {entries.map((entry) => (
              <TableRow key={entry.id}>
                <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                  {format.dateTime(
                    new Date(entry.occurredAt.epochMilliseconds),
                    { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" },
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                  {entry.eventType ??
                    `${entry.op ?? "change"} ${entry.table ?? ""}`.trim()}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="hidden max-w-48 truncate md:table-cell">
                  {entry.actorLabel ?? entry.actorId ?? "–"}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="hidden max-w-48 truncate md:table-cell">
                  {entry.targetLabel ?? entry.record ?? "–"}
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      )}
      {hasMore ? (
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="justify-self-center"
          disabled={loading}
          onClick={() => {
            void loadMore();
          }}
        >
          {t("Load more")}
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Button`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/audit-log-table.tsx"
import { useAuditLog } from "better-supabase/blocks/audit/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { ActivityIndicator, Button, Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/** A row of chips that filters by one value, or by none. */
function Chips({
  values,
  selected,
  onSelect,
}: {
  readonly values: readonly string[];
  readonly selected: string | undefined;
  readonly onSelect: (value: string | undefined) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
      {[undefined, ...values].map((value) => (
        <Pressable
          key={value ?? "all"}
          accessibilityRole="radio"
          accessibilityState={{ checked: value === selected }}
          onPress={() => {
            onSelect(value);
          }}
          style={{
            borderWidth: 1,
            borderRadius: 16,
            paddingHorizontal: 10,
            paddingVertical: 2,
            backgroundColor: value === selected ? "#e5e5e5" : undefined,
          }}
        >
          <Text>{value ?? "All"}</Text>
        </Pressable>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The organization's audit trail, newest first, filtered by actor and by
 * action with the values on the loaded page. Members without `audit.read`
 * get the module's error.
 */
export function AuditLogTable() {
  const { entries, filters, hasMore, loading, error, setFilters, loadMore } =
    useAuditLog({ organizationId: tenantOf(useAuth()), schema: API_SCHEMA });

  const distinct = (values: readonly (string | undefined)[]) =>
    [...new Set(values.filter((value) => value !== undefined))].toSorted();

  const actors = distinct([
    ...(entries ?? []).map((entry) => entry.actorId),
    filters.actorId,
  ]);

  const actions = distinct([
    ...(entries ?? []).map((entry) => entry.eventType),
    filters.eventType,
  ]);

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      <Text style={{ fontSize: 17, fontWeight: "600" }}>Audit log</Text>
      <Chips
        values={actors}
        selected={filters.actorId}
        onSelect={(actorId) => void setFilters({ ...filters, actorId })}
      />
      <Chips
        values={actions}
        selected={filters.eventType}
        onSelect={(eventType) => void setFilters({ ...filters, eventType })}
      />
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
      {entries === undefined ? (
        <ActivityIndicator />
      ) : (
        entries.map((entry) => (
          <View key={entry.id} style={{ paddingVertical: 6 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
              {entry.eventType ?? entry.op}
            </Text>
            <Text style={{ color: "#737373", fontSize: 12 }}>
              {entry.occurredAt.toLocaleString()} by{" "}
              {entry.actorLabel ?? entry.actorId ?? "the system"}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ))
      )}
      {hasMore ? (
        <Button
          title="Load more"
          disabled={loading}
          onPress={() => void loadMore()}
        />
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Tag input

A record's tags with suggestions, where typing a name adds a tag or creates it. Both sides call `useTagInput` from `better-supabase/blocks/tags/react`; the [tags block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/tags) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add tags`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/tag-input.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button input skeleton
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/customers/components/tag-input.tsx"
"use client";

import { useTagInput } from "better-supabase/blocks/tags/react";
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { type SubmitEvent, useId, useState } from "react";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { blockConfig } from "@/lib/supabase/blocks.generated";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

/**
 * A customer's tags. Typing a name adds the organization's tag with that
 * name, or creates it for callers with `tags.manage`.
 */
export function TagInput({
  organizationId,
  customerId,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  customerId: string;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("customers");
  const listId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();
  const [name, setName] = useState("");

  const { tags, available, pending, error, create, remove } = useTagInput({
    organizationId,
    subjectType: "customer",
    subjectId: customerId,
    kind: "customer",
    schema: blockConfig.tags.api,
  });

  const applied = new Set(tags?.map((tag) => tag.id));
  const suggestions = available?.filter((tag) => !applied.has(tag.id)) ?? [];

  const submit = async (event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();

    if (!name.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    if ((await create(name)).ok) {
      setName("");
    }
  };

  if (tags === undefined) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-16" />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <ul className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" data-testid="tags">
        {tags.length === 0 ? (
          <li className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("No tags yet.")}</li>
        ) : null}
        {tags.map((tag) => (
          <li key={tag.id}>
            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className={pending.includes(tag.id) ? "opacity-50" : undefined}
            >
              {tag.name}
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label={t("Remove {name}", { name: tag.name })}
                disabled={pending.includes(tag.id)}
                onClick={() => {
                  void remove(tag.id);
                }}
              >
                <XIcon className="size-3" />
              </button>
            </Badge>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <form onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex gap-2">
        <Input
          value={name}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setName(event.target.value);
          }}
          list={listId}
          maxLength={80}
          placeholder={t("Add a tag")}
          aria-label={t("Tag")}
        />
        <datalist id={listId}>
          {suggestions.map((tag) => (
            <option key={tag.id} value={tag.name}>
              {tag.name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </datalist>
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" disabled={!name.trim()}>
          {t("Add")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      {error ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{errorMessage(error)}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

React Native, with `ActivityIndicator`, `Button`, `Pressable`, `Text`, `TextInput`, `View` from `react-native`:

```tsx title="apps/examples/expo-powersync/src/components/tag-input.tsx"
import { useTagInput } from "better-supabase/blocks/tags/react";
import { tenantOf, useAuth } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Button,
  Pressable,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";

import { API_SCHEMA } from "../lib/blocks";

/**
 * A customer's tags as chips that remove themselves when pressed, the
 * organization's other tags as suggestions, and a field that adds or
 * creates one by name.
 */
export function TagInput({ customerId }: { readonly customerId: string }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");

  const { tags, available, pending, error, add, remove, create } = useTagInput({
    organizationId: tenantOf(useAuth()),
    subjectType: "customer",
    subjectId: customerId,
    kind: "customer",
    schema: API_SCHEMA,
  });

  if (tags === undefined) {
    return <ActivityIndicator />;
  }

  const applied = new Set(tags.map((tag) => tag.id));
  const suggestions = (available ?? []).filter((tag) => !applied.has(tag.id));

  const chip = (label: string, busy: boolean, onPress: () => void) => (
    <Pressable
      key={label}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      disabled={busy}
      onPress={onPress}
      style={{
        borderWidth: 1,
        borderRadius: 16,
        paddingHorizontal: 10,
        paddingVertical: 2,
        opacity: busy ? 0.5 : 1,
      }}
    >
      <Text>{label}</Text>
    </Pressable>
  );

  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
        {tags.length === 0 ? <Text>No tags yet.</Text> : null}
        {tags.map((tag) =>
          chip(`${tag.name} ×`, pending.includes(tag.id), () => {
            void remove(tag.id);
          }),
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 6 }}>
        {suggestions.map((tag) =>
          chip(`+ ${tag.name}`, pending.includes(tag.id), () => {
            void add(tag.id);
          }),
        )}
      </View>
      {error ? <Text style={{ color: "#b91c1c" }}>{error.message}</Text> : null}
      <TextInput
        value={name}
        onChangeText={setName}
        placeholder="Add a tag"
        maxLength={80}
        style={{ borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 8, padding: 8 }}
      />
      <Button
        title="Add"
        disabled={!name.trim()}
        onPress={() =>
          void create(name).then((result) => {
            if (result.ok) {
              setName("");
            }
          })
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Announcement banner

The newest live announcement for the user and organization, with a dismiss button. It calls `useAnnouncements` from `better-supabase/blocks/announcements/react`; the [announcements block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/announcements) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add announcements`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/announcement-banner.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add alert button
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/announcements/components/announcement-banner.tsx"
"use client";

import { useAnnouncements } from "better-supabase/blocks/announcements/react";
import { MegaphoneIcon, XIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";

import {
  Alert,
  AlertAction,
  AlertDescription,
  AlertTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

/**
 * The newest live announcement for this user and organization. Loads in
 * the browser and reloads on the module's broadcast, so it adds nothing to
 * the server render.
 */
export function AnnouncementBanner({
  organizationId,
}: {
  organizationId: string | null;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("announcements");

  const { items, dismiss } = useAnnouncements({
    organizationId,
    schema: "api",
  });

  const announcement = items?.[0];

  if (!announcement) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <Alert
      variant={announcement.severity === "critical" ? "destructive" : "default"}
      data-testid="announcement"
    >
      <MegaphoneIcon />
      <AlertTitle>{announcement.title}</AlertTitle>
      {announcement.body ? (
        <AlertDescription>{announcement.body}</AlertDescription>
      ) : null}
      {announcement.dismissible ? (
        <AlertAction>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="icon-sm"
            aria-label={t("Dismiss")}
            onClick={() => void dismiss(announcement.id)}
          >
            <XIcon />
          </Button>
        </AlertAction>
      ) : null}
    </Alert>
  );
}
```

## Two-factor setup

A card that enrolls an authenticator app with a QR code, verifies the first code and removes the factor. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [mfa block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/mfa) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add mfa`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/mfa-setup.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge button card field input-otp
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/user/components/two-factor-card.tsx"
"use client";

import { useSessionChange } from "better-supabase/next/client";
import { ShieldCheckIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useId, useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Card,
  CardAction,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import {
  InputOTP,
  InputOTPGroup,
  InputOTPSlot,
} from "@/components/ui/input-otp";
import { useSupabase } from "@/lib/hooks";

import type { AuthRead } from "../security-queries";

import { sessionChanged } from "../user-actions";

interface Enrollment {
  readonly factorId: string;
  readonly qrCode: string;
  readonly secret: string;
}

/**
 * TOTP through Supabase Auth MFA. The server reads the verified factor
 * (`getTotpFactorId`), so it is in the prefetched page; enrolling and
 * verifying run in the browser. A verified factor raises the session to
 * `aal2`, which `deleteMyAccount` and `DELETE /api/customers/:id` require.
 */
export function TwoFactorCard({
  initial,
}: {
  readonly initial: AuthRead<string | null>;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("security");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const supabase = useSupabase();
  const changeSession = useSessionChange(sessionChanged);

  const refreshAndChange = useSessionChange(sessionChanged, undefined, {
    refreshToken: supabase,
  });

  const [factorId, setFactorId] = useState(initial.ok ? initial.value : null);
  const readError = initial.ok ? null : initial.error;
  const [enrollment, setEnrollment] = useState<Enrollment | null>(null);
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const enroll = () => {
    startTransition(async () => {
      setError(null);

      const { data, error: enrollError } = await supabase.auth.mfa.enroll({
        factorType: "totp",
        friendlyName: `Acme Cloud ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
      });

      if (enrollError) {
        setError(enrollError.message);

        return;
      }

      setEnrollment({
        factorId: data.id,
        qrCode: data.totp.qr_code,
        secret: data.totp.secret,
      });
    });
  };

  const verify = () => {
    if (!enrollment) {
      return;
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.mfa.challengeAndVerify(
        {
          factorId: enrollment.factorId,
          code,
        },
      );

      if (verifyError) {
        setError(t("That code didn't work. Try the next one."));

        return;
      }

      await changeSession();
      setFactorId(enrollment.factorId);
      setEnrollment(null);
      setCode("");
      toast.success(t("Two-factor authentication is on"));
    });
  };

  const remove = () => {
    if (!factorId) {
      return;
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      const { error: removeError } = await supabase.auth.mfa.unenroll({
        factorId,
      });

      if (removeError) {
        toast.error(removeError.message);

        return;
      }

      await refreshAndChange();
      setFactorId(null);
      toast.success(t("Two-factor authentication is off"));
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>{t("Two-factor authentication")}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          {t(
            "An authenticator app code at sign-in. Needed to delete your account.",
          )}
        </CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          {readError ? null : factorId ? (
            <Badge data-testid="mfa-status">
              <ShieldCheckIcon />
              {t("On")}
            </Badge>
          ) : (
            <Badge variant="secondary" data-testid="mfa-status">
              {t("Off")}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
        {readError ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{readError}</p>
        ) : enrollment ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-start">
            {/* An SVG data URL from Supabase Auth: nothing to optimize. */}
            <Image
              src={enrollment.qrCode}
              width={160}
              height={160}
              unoptimized
              alt={t("QR code for your authenticator app")}
              className="rounded-lg bg-white p-2"
            />
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-totp-code`}>
                  {t("Code from the app")}
                </FieldLabel>
                <InputOTP
                  id={`${fieldId}-totp-code`}
                  maxLength={6}
                  value={code}
                  onChange={setCode}
                >
                  <InputOTPGroup>
                    {Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, index) => (
                      <InputOTPSlot key={index} index={index} />
                    ))}
                  </InputOTPGroup>
                </InputOTP>
                <FieldDescription>
                  {t("Or enter this key by hand: {secret}", {
                    secret: enrollment.secret,
                  })}
                </FieldDescription>
                {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
              </Field>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button
                  onClick={verify}
                  disabled={pending || code.length !== 6}
                >
                  {t("Verify")}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setEnrollment(null);
                  }}
                >
                  {t("Cancel")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : factorId ? (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={remove} disabled={pending}>
            {t("Turn off")}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Button onClick={enroll} disabled={pending}>
              {t("Set up")}
            </Button>
            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p> : null}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Inbox with threads

A shared inbox of conversations with status tabs, an assignee filter and the open thread beside the list. It calls `useInbox` from `better-supabase/blocks/inbox/react`; the [inbox block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/inbox) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add inbox`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/inbox-threads.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add badge empty select tabs
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/inbox/components/inbox-view.tsx"
"use client";

import { useInbox } from "better-supabase/blocks/inbox/react";
import { InboxIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useExtracted, useFormatter } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import * as v from "valibot";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Empty,
  EmptyDescription,
  EmptyHeader,
  EmptyMedia,
  EmptyTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/empty";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { loadConversations } from "../inbox-actions";
import { unwrap } from "../inbox-load";
import {
  AssigneeFilter,
  type ConversationRow,
  ConversationStatus,
} from "../inbox-types";
import { ConversationPanel } from "./conversation-panel";

export function InboxView({
  organizationId,
  initial,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  initial: readonly ConversationRow[];
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("inbox");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ConversationStatus>("open");
  const [assignee, setAssignee] = useState<AssigneeFilter>("anyone");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const assigneeItems = [
    { value: "anyone", label: t("Anyone") },
    { value: "me", label: t("Mine") },
    { value: "unassigned", label: t("Unassigned") },
  ] satisfies readonly { value: AssigneeFilter; label: string }[];

  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-128 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <section aria-label={t("Conversations")} className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <Tabs
            value={status}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              if (!v.is(ConversationStatus, value)) {
                return;
              }

              setStatus(value);
            }}
          >
            <TabsList>
              <TabsTrigger value="open">{t("Open")}</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="pending">{t("Pending")}</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="resolved">{t("Resolved")}</TabsTrigger>
              <TabsTrigger value="all">{t("All")}</TabsTrigger>
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>
          <Select
            value={assignee}
            items={assigneeItems}
            onValueChange={(value) => {
              if (!v.is(AssigneeFilter, value)) {
                return;
              }

              setAssignee(value);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger
              size="sm"
              className="w-32"
              aria-label={t("Assignee")}
            >
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {assigneeItems.map((item) => (
                <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
                  {item.label}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
        <ConversationList
          key={`${status}:${assignee}`}
          organizationId={organizationId}
          status={status}
          assignee={assignee}
          initial={status === "open" && assignee === "anyone" ? initial : []}
          selected={selected}
          onSelect={setSelected}
        />
      </section>
      {selected === null ? (
        <Empty className="border lg:col-span-2">
          <EmptyHeader>
            <EmptyTitle>{t("Pick a conversation")}</EmptyTitle>
            <EmptyDescription>
              {t("Its messages, notes and actions show here.")}
            </EmptyDescription>
          </EmptyHeader>
        </Empty>
      ) : (
        <div className="lg:col-span-2">
          <ConversationPanel key={selected} conversationId={selected} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ConversationList({
  organizationId,
  status,
  assignee,
  initial,
  selected,
  onSelect,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  status: ConversationStatus;
  assignee: AssigneeFilter;
  initial: readonly ConversationRow[];
  selected: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("inbox");
  const format = useFormatter();

  const inbox = useInbox({
    organizationId,
    load: async () => unwrap(await loadConversations({ status, assignee })),
  });

  const conversations = inbox.items ?? initial;

  // Staff reads send no broadcast, so an opened conversation clears its badge here.
  const [openedAt, setOpenedAt] = useState<ReadonlyMap<string, number>>(
    () => new Map(),
  );

  const unread = (conversation: ConversationRow): boolean => {
    const opened = openedAt.get(conversation.id);

    return (
      conversation.unread &&
      (opened === undefined ||
        (conversation.lastMessageAt !== null &&
          Date.parse(conversation.lastMessageAt) > opened))
    );
  };

  return conversations.length === 0 ? (
    <Empty className="border">
      <EmptyHeader>
        <EmptyMedia variant="icon">
          <InboxIcon />
        </EmptyMedia>
        <EmptyTitle>{t("No conversations")}</EmptyTitle>
        <EmptyDescription>
          {t("Open Help in the header to start one as a customer.")}
        </EmptyDescription>
      </EmptyHeader>
    </Empty>
  ) : (
    <ul className="divide-y rounded-xl border">
      {conversations.map((conversation) => (
        <li key={conversation.id}>
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-current={selected === conversation.id ? "true" : undefined}
            className={cn(
              "flex w-full flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3 text-left text-sm hover:bg-muted/50",
              selected === conversation.id && "bg-muted",
            )}
            onClick={() => {
              setOpenedAt((current) =>
                new Map(current).set(conversation.id, Date.now()),
              );
              onSelect(conversation.id);
            }}
          >
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="flex-1 truncate font-medium">
                {conversation.contactName || t("Visitor")}
              </span>
              {unread(conversation) ? <Badge>{t("New")}</Badge> : null}
            </span>
            <span className="truncate">
              {conversation.subject ?? t("No subject")}
            </span>
            <span className="flex gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="flex-1 truncate">{conversation.preview}</span>
              {conversation.lastMessageAt ? (
                <span className="tabular-nums">
                  {format.dateTime(new Date(conversation.lastMessageAt), {
                    dateStyle: "short",
                    timeStyle: "short",
                  })}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </button>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## Workspace URL field

An organization form with a name and a URL slug, where reserved and taken slugs come back as field errors. It loads its data on the server through the block's client; the [organizations](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/organizations), [reserved-slugs](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/reserved-slugs) blocks must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add organizations reserved-slugs`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/workspace-url-field.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button field input
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/organization/components/organization-form.tsx"
"use client";

import { useActionForm } from "better-supabase/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldGroup,
  FieldLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/use-error-message";

import { updateOrganization } from "../organization-actions";

export function OrganizationForm({
  name,
  slug,
  canEdit,
}: {
  name: string;
  slug: string;
  canEdit: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("organization");
  const fieldId = useId();
  const errorMessage = useErrorMessage();

  const form = useActionForm(updateOrganization, {
    resetOnSuccess: false,
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success(t("Organization saved"));
    },
  });

  const error =
    form.error === undefined
      ? null
      : form.error.kind === "conflict"
        ? t("That URL is taken. Pick another one.")
        : errorMessage(form.error);

  return (
    <form {...form.formProps} className="space-y-6">
      <fieldset disabled={!canEdit}>
        <FieldGroup>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-organization-name`}>
              {t("Name")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-organization-name`}
              name="name"
              defaultValue={name}
              required
              minLength={2}
              maxLength={80}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field data-invalid={error ? true : undefined}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${fieldId}-organization-slug`}>
              {t("URL")}
            </FieldLabel>
            <Input
              id={`${fieldId}-organization-slug`}
              name="slug"
              defaultValue={slug}
              required
              pattern="[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]*[a-z0-9]"
              maxLength={48}
              aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
            />
            <FieldDescription>
              {t("Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.")}
            </FieldDescription>
            {error ? <FieldError>{error}</FieldError> : null}
          </Field>
        </FieldGroup>
      </fieldset>
      {canEdit ? (
        <Button type="submit" disabled={form.pending}>
          {t("Save")}
        </Button>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {t("Only owners and admins can change the organization.")}
        </p>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Chat with history

An AI chat that stores every message, resumes a stored conversation and streams the reply. It calls `useAssistant` from `better-supabase/ai-sdk/react`; the [ai-chat block](https://bettersupabase.com/blocks/ai-chat) must be installed (`npx better-supabase sql add ai-chat`). Page: https://bettersupabase.com/recipes/chat-with-history.

Web, with shadcn components:

```bash
npx shadcn add button textarea
```

```tsx title="apps/examples/nextjs/src/features/assistant/components/assistant-chat.tsx"
"use client";

import type { UIMessage } from "ai";

import { useAssistant } from "better-supabase/ai-sdk/react";
import { useDurableAssistant } from "better-supabase/ai-sdk/workflow/react";
import { useExtracted } from "next-intl";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { ChatView } from "./chat-view";

export type ChatMode = "standard" | "durable" | "research";

interface PanelProps {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly messages: UIMessage[];
  readonly streaming: boolean;
}

/** The answer streams from the request; a reload picks it up from the stream store. */
function StandardPanel({ id, messages }: PanelProps) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const chat = useAssistant({
    id,
    messages,
    onFinish: () => {
      router.refresh();
    },
  });

  return <ChatView id={id} chat={chat} />;
}

/** The answer runs as a workflow: it survives a closed tab and waits for approvals. */
function DurablePanel({
  id,
  messages,
  streaming,
  agent,
}: PanelProps & { readonly agent: "assistant" | "research" }) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const chat = useDurableAssistant({
    id,
    api: "/api/chat/durable",
    body: { agent },
    messages,
    resume: streaming,
    onFinish: () => {
      router.refresh();
    },
  });

  return <ChatView id={id} chat={chat} />;
}

/**
 * One chat. Standard answers stream from the request; Durable and Research
 * answers run as workflows, which need the AI Gateway key.
 */
export function AssistantChat({
  id,
  messages,
  streaming = false,
  initialMode = "standard",
  durableAvailable,
}: {
  id: string;
  messages: UIMessage[];
  streaming?: boolean;
  initialMode?: ChatMode;
  durableAvailable: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useExtracted("assistant");

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ChatMode>(
    durableAvailable ? initialMode : "standard",
  );

  const modes: readonly { mode: ChatMode; label: string }[] = [
    { mode: "standard", label: t("Standard") },
    { mode: "durable", label: t("Durable") },
    { mode: "research", label: t("Research") },
  ];

  const panel = { id, messages, streaming };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <fieldset className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <legend className="sr-only">{t("Answer mode")}</legend>
        {modes.map((entry) => (
          <Button
            key={entry.mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={mode === entry.mode ? "default" : "outline"}
            aria-pressed={mode === entry.mode}
            disabled={entry.mode !== "standard" && !durableAvailable}
            onClick={() => {
              setMode(entry.mode);
            }}
          >
            {entry.label}
          </Button>
        ))}
        {durableAvailable ? null : (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {t("Durable answers need AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY.")}
          </p>
        )}
      </fieldset>
      {mode === "standard" ? (
        <StandardPanel key="standard" {...panel} />
      ) : (
        <DurablePanel
          key={mode}
          {...panel}
          agent={mode === "research" ? "research" : "assistant"}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
